verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's own docs show that users pick among multiple GPU instance types, comparing them in Capacity Finder and running them in separate Node Pools. A community comment adds that the fleet is "all datacenter GPUs." No evidence names H100/H200/B200-class hardware or cheaper previous-generation tiers. Missing for 10: named current-generation GPU models (H100/H200/B200), documented previous-generation options with lower pricing, a published instance-type catalog or pricing table, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: use Capacity Finder in the Cloud Console to compare placement availability across Zones for one or more GPU and CPU instance types
This lets you run different types of workloads on different types of Nodes
It's all datacenter GPUs as per their website.
